raw.text: SO SORRY! Inadvertently, the article appearing in the April, 1958, issue featuring the Remodeling of the Building at 25 First Street, San Francisco, carried a By-Line of William B.

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 25 01ST ST → parcel 3709011; sf-parcels has blklot 3709011 active, 21–25 01ST; the 2025 roll records it as commercial office, built 1988. EAS puts 21, 25 01ST ST on that parcel, so per the directory contract the fact belongs on one page at the lowest, 21.
resolution.note: The roll dates the building on this parcel to 1988; the building remodeled in 1958 is gone.
